title: Session Submit Results Request
description: POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/results request. Top-level config is accepted alongside the existing metadata.config fallback for native-local SDK submissions.

trial_id.x-content-note: INV-GAP: was opaque_ref; contract has no ref pattern, so the value is not provably content-free
trial_id.description: Canonical trial/configuration-run identifier for the submitted result. Workflow spans for this same trial MUST be ingested with SpanBatch.configuration_run_id and SpanPayload.configuration_run_id equal to this value.

metrics.description: Per-measure scores for this trial. Inherits the canonical MeasuresDict contract enforced by the backend at the boundary (max 50 keys, identifier keys, numeric|null values).

config_refs.description: Content-less trial configuration as knob_ref -> choice_ref|number (phase 2, additive), sent instead of config.

metric_values.description: Content-less per-measure scores keyed by metric_ref (phase 2, additive), sent instead of metrics.

config.description: Optional SDK-owned trial configuration. For native-local submissions this may replace metadata.config.

execution_mode.description: Optional SDK execution mode label for this submission (e.g. 'local', 'hybrid'). Backend validates it as an optional string capped at 64 chars (src/routes/traigent_session_routes.py::_validate_results_payload) and uses it to record deprecated-wire-format telemetry and, on the interactive (typed) path, as metadata.mode (the classic path receives it as its own execution_mode argument, not via metadata).

strategy_preset.description: Optional advisory strategy preset metadata recorded for this trial result.

measures.description: Legacy location for per-measure scores (backend reads metadata.measures when top-level measures is absent). Two backend-supported shapes, dispatched by _extract_submission_measures / _validate_submission_measures in src/routes/traigent_session_routes.py: a flat metric-name-to-number MeasuresDict (routed to validate_measures_dict, strict=true) -- same contract as the top-level measures field -- or a list of per-example ExampleMetrics objects (routed to validate_measures_list), the form that carries the per-example sibling identity fields (input_id, example_digest, output_digest, verified_match, signal_key_id).

content_identity.description: Optional content identity envelope for this trial result (content identity M3 PR-5-lite; execution/content_identity_wire_v1_schema.json TrialContentIdentityWireV1). A CLIENT DECLARATION only: TraigentBackend src/services/content_identity/run_binding.py never rejects the results submission over this field, whatever its shape, and it binds only when the session's own content_identity already produced a run binding (a trial identity sent without a session binding is accepted but not bound). A schema-valid envelope is recomputed and stored as facts (see GET .../identity-binding); an object that fails TrialContentIdentityWireV1, a non-object value, or an oversized block is still accepted here and stored as a draft trial binding with rejection_reason set. The permissive second branch exists so this declaration stays additive and never turns an already-accepted results submission into a 400.

execution_environment.description: Optional opaque SDK execution environment metadata (e.g. runtime/platform info). Backend validates it as an optional object only and passes it through unvalidated to the session service on the classic (non-interactive) submission path (src/routes/traigent_session_routes.py::_validate_results_payload).

summary_stats.description: Optional trial-level summary statistics (e.g. aggregated per-example scores). Backend validates it as an optional object only and passes it through unvalidated to the session service on both the interactive and classic submission paths (src/routes/traigent_session_routes.py::_validate_results_payload).

measures.description: Optional per-measure scores. Two backend-supported shapes, dispatched by _validate_submission_measures in src/routes/traigent_session_routes.py: a flat metric-name-to-number MeasuresDict object (routed to validate_measures_dict, strict=true: max 50 keys, metric-name keys ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*$, numeric|null values), or a list of per-example ExampleMetrics objects (routed to validate_measures_list instead), the form that carries the per-example sibling identity fields (input_id, example_digest, output_digest, verified_match, signal_key_id).
